transcript.text: Good afternoon, everyone. Thank you for joining. As you know, the audit committee has asked me to present a recommended resolution plan this Friday regarding the anonymous report alleging that a procurement VP steered technology purchases toward a preferred supplier. The preliminary review looked at the procurement policy, selected emails, and payment records but didn't reach a final conclusion. Before I can present anything to the audit committee, company practice requires me to get a final check from investigations, finance, employment, and insurance counsel. I'd like to discuss how we approach this efficiently so we're ready by Friday. Does anyone have an update from their area?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to share an important update from the investigations side. After conducting two additional witness interviews this week, I've concluded that the procurement vice president did steer the purchases toward the preferred supplier in violation of company policy. I have not yet finalized that conclusion in the preliminary review memorandum, but based on what I've gathered, the investigation findings support a substantiated violation.

transcript.text: I have an important update from the finance side. Yesterday I completed a reconciliation of the supplier invoices against the approved purchase orders for the transactions under review. I can confirm that the company overpaid exactly $240,000 on those transactions. This reconciliation was completed yesterday and is not included in the preliminary review packet, so we'll need to incorporate this figure into the resolution plan for Friday.
